name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: As a paladin, you learn that the Holy Light calls for selflessness, charity, and lasting duty to ordinary citizens before martial glory.
As a dwarf paladin, you report to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge after your trials in Dun Morogh. You account for your deeds in the wider world.
As an Alliance member, you see close ties between Ironforge and Stormwind in the mentors and travelers who pass between these great cities.

aliases: what is the tome of divinity
faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity tests novice paladins in compassion, charity, and self-sacrifice. Its trials ask more of them than strength in battle.
faq.q: What is the Tome of Divinity?

faq.answer: Tiza Battleforge is a paladin mentor in Ironforge. She guides initiates and judges whether their deeds follow the Holy Light.
Stephanie Turner is John Turner's wife in Stormwind. They run an orphanage together, and John hopes to return to her after gathering supplies in Ironforge.
Tiza Battleforge listens to how a returning initiate served others. She asks how they helped a noble cause and aided ordinary citizens before granting her blessing.
faq.q: What does Tiza Battleforge ask of returning initiates?

aliases: why speak to tiza in ironforge
faq.answer: Initiates return to Ironforge to tell Tiza Battleforge what they did. By helping John Turner in the city, they show compassion and selflessness.
faq.q: Why must initiates report to Ironforge?

aliases: how does the light reward sacrifice
faq.answer: Paladin teachings place the welfare of others above one's own. Tiza teaches that selfless sacrifice will be rewarded in time.
faq.q: Why is self-sacrifice central to this trial?

sections.body: Paladins begin their trials by learning humility, duty, and charity. Tiza Battleforge does not ask for feats of arms. A servant of the Holy Light must understand the troubles ordinary people face and offer help without seeking praise or gain.
sections.title: Lessons of the Holy Light

sections.body: After helping someone in Ironforge, an aspiring paladin returns to Tiza Battleforge. The initiate tells her how they spent their time away and whose burdens they helped bear. When she is satisfied that they acted with charity and duty, Tiza commends them. Such selfless service is what it means to follow the Light.
sections.title: Accounting Before Ironforge

summary: In Ironforge, Tiza Battleforge teaches initiates what service to the Holy Light demands. They aid someone in need, then return to tell her how they served.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Divinity
